calibration_policy: For each held-out capture, reserve the first two eligible benign captures from the same dataset, excluding the test capture; exclude calibration captures from training; take the maximum per-capture 99th percentile threshold.
limitations: One seed, reduced 1,000-row cap, and the same 18 captures; exploratory only.
Dataset identity is known for offline evaluation; this does not calibrate an unknown future dataset.
No production model, decision threshold, or existing report was changed.
